why: A Casting row that names a provider row (wave 13n, piece 4(b)) is refused at the Casting door and the provider door, and at the run-models door when a check starts. The last needs a key file beside the database, an inspector the person registered and a dsh or codex row of its own, which no door here has. tests/a-casting-row-names-a-provider-row-for-a-dsh-check.test.ts meets each refusal of a dsh row through its door, in cases 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, and tests/a-codex-check-takes-its-one-key-from-a-provider-row.test.ts each refusal of a codex row, in cases 1, 2, 4 and 6.
